### Comparación Cross-Framework (Larch vs Biogeme) — Nested Extendido v2

Esta celda usa el comparador del repo (`03_models/compare_nested_ext_v2_frameworks.py`) para revisar:

- `LL_final`, AIC/BIC y `Rho-square-bar`
- el **parámetro del nido** bajo una comparación consistente (`μ ↔ λ`)
- alertas de posible no-convergencia en Larch vía `Final gradient norm`

#### ¿Qué significa “matched”?

En este repositorio usamos **matched sample** para decir: *un archivo parquet ya muestreado y con features listos*,
de modo que **Biogeme y Larch estiman sobre exactamente las mismas filas** (eliminamos diferencias por muestreo).

Ejemplo: `tmp/matched_samples/nested_ext_v2_2025-W17_sample20pct-matched.parquet`.

#### Corrida “óptima” en Larch (benchmark)

En nested logit, el óptimo puede depender de método e inicialización de `MU_QR`. Para robustez:

1) correr un benchmark multi-start/multi-method (genera `...-benchbest/`), y
2) cargar esa carpeta como “Larch óptimo” y compararla contra Biogeme.

````{python}
#|label: run-benchmark-nested-ext-v2-larch
#|eval: false
print("label: run-benchmark-nested-ext-v2-larch")

# Ejecuta el benchmark desde el script del repo (recomendado), y deja outputs en:
#   `<BASE_OUTPUT_DIR>/<partition>-nested-ext-v2-<spec>-<mode>-<sample>-benchbest/`
#
# Nota: se corre como subprocess y fuerza threads a 1 para evitar crashes tipo "heap corruption"
# cuando se ejecutan muchas optimizaciones seguidas.

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BENCH_PARTITION = "2025-W17"
BENCH_SPEC = "specific"
BENCH_MODE = "noModeDummies"
BENCH_SAMPLE = "sample20pct-matched"
BENCH_OVERWRITE = True  # True => reescribe carpetas existentes

LARCH_METHODS = "slsqp,trust-constr"
LARCH_MU_STARTS = "0.2,0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8,0.9"
LARCH_MAXITER = "400"

SCRIPT = PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "validation" / "nested_ext_v2_validations.py"
if not SCRIPT.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe el script: {SCRIPT}")

matched_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "matched_samples" / f"nested_ext_v2_{BENCH_PARTITION}_{BENCH_SAMPLE}.parquet"
if not matched_path.exists():
    print(f"⚠️ No existe matched sample: {matched_path}")
    print("➡️  Creándolo automáticamente con el script del repo...")
    export_cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        "-Xfrozen_modules=off",
        str(SCRIPT),
        "--export-matched-sample",
        "--partition",
        BENCH_PARTITION,
        "--sample",
        BENCH_SAMPLE,
    ]
    print("$ " + " ".join(export_cmd))
    subprocess.run(export_cmd, check=True, cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT), env=os.environ)
    if not matched_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No se pudo crear matched sample: {matched_path}")

# Preferimos usar el mismo python del kernel (asumiendo que el notebook se corre dentro de larch-env).
py = sys.executable

env = dict(os.environ)
env.setdefault("NUMBA_CACHE_DIR", str(PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "numba_cache"))
env.setdefault("MPLCONFIGDIR", str(PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp" / "mplcache"))
env.setdefault("XDG_CACHE_HOME", str(PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp"))
env.setdefault("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", str(PROJECT_ROOT / "tmp"))
env.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "1")
env.setdefault("MKL_NUM_THREADS", "1")
env.setdefault("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "1")
env.setdefault("NUMEXPR_MAX_THREADS", "1")
env.setdefault("VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS", "1")

cmd = [
    py,
    "-Xfrozen_modules=off",
    str(SCRIPT),
    "--benchmark-larch",
    "--partition", BENCH_PARTITION,
    "--spec", BENCH_SPEC,
    "--mode", BENCH_MODE,
    "--sample", BENCH_SAMPLE,
    "--matched-sample-path", str(matched_path),
    "--larch-output-root", str(Path(BASE_OUTPUT_DIR)),
    "--larch-methods", LARCH_METHODS,
    "--larch-mu-starts", LARCH_MU_STARTS,
    "--larch-maxiter", LARCH_MAXITER,
    "--larch-quiet",
]
if BENCH_OVERWRITE:
    cmd.append("--overwrite")

print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT), env=env)
print("✅ Benchmark terminado. Ahora puedes cargar `...-benchbest` en las celdas siguientes.")
````

import runpy
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

COMPARE_PARTITION = "2025-W17"
COMPARE_SPEC = "specific"  # "generic" | "specific"
COMPARE_MODE = "noModeDummies"  # "noModeDummies" | "modeDummies"
COMPARE_BIOGEME_SAMPLE = "sample20pct-matched"
COMPARE_LARCH_SAMPLE = "sample20pct-matched-benchbest"

PROJECT_ROOT = Path().resolve()
while PROJECT_ROOT != PROJECT_ROOT.parent:
    if (PROJECT_ROOT / "03_models").is_dir() and (PROJECT_ROOT / "config").is_dir():
        break
    PROJECT_ROOT = PROJECT_ROOT.parent

cmp_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "03_models" / "compare_nested_ext_v2_frameworks.py"
if not cmp_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe el comparador: {cmp_path}")

mod = runpy.run_path(str(cmp_path))
RunKey = mod["RunKey"]
compare = mod["compare"]
compare_two = mod.get("compare_two", None)

key_b = RunKey(
    partition=COMPARE_PARTITION,
    spec=COMPARE_SPEC,
    mode=COMPARE_MODE,
    sample=COMPARE_BIOGEME_SAMPLE,
)
key_l = RunKey(
    partition=COMPARE_PARTITION,
    spec=COMPARE_SPEC,
    mode=COMPARE_MODE,
    sample=COMPARE_LARCH_SAMPLE,
)

if COMPARE_BIOGEME_SAMPLE != COMPARE_LARCH_SAMPLE and compare_two is not None:
    out = compare_two(key_b, key_l)
else:
    out = compare(key_b)

print("\n=== Stats (Larch vs Biogeme) ===")
display(pd.DataFrame([out["stats"]]))

print("\n=== Nest parameter (μ/λ normalizado) ===")
display(pd.DataFrame([out["nest"]]))

print("\n=== Params (Larch vs Biogeme) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", 200, "display.max_columns", 30):
    display(out["params"])

    df_s = df_params_nl_ext_v2_larch[df_params_nl_ext_v2_larch["Spec"] == "specific"].copy()
    if len(df_s) == 0:
        print("⚠️ No hay parámetros v2 specific (Larch).")
    else:
        if SHOW_ALL_SPECIFIC_PARAMS:
            df_show = df_s
            title = "Tabla Larch v2 (specific, ALL)"
        else:
            key_params = [
                "MU_QR",
                "ASC_QR_RED",
                "ASC_QR_OTHER",
                # Temporales
                "B_QR_RED_PM_LAB",
                "B_QR_OTHER_PM_LAB",
                "B_QR_RED_PT_LAB",
                "B_QR_OTHER_PT_LAB",
                "B_QR_RED_LJ_LAB",
                "B_QR_OTHER_LJ_LAB",
                "B_QR_RED_VIE_LAB",
                "B_QR_OTHER_VIE_LAB",
                # Atributos de viaje
                "B_QR_RED_T_VEHICULO",
                "B_QR_OTHER_T_VEHICULO",
                "B_QR_RED_N_TRASBORDOS",
                "B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASBORDOS",
                "B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB",
                "B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB",
                "B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI",
                "B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI",
                # Dummies modales
                "B_QR_RED_SOLO_METRO",
                "B_QR_OTHER_SOLO_METRO",
                "B_QR_RED_METRO_BUS",
                "B_QR_OTHER_METRO_BUS",
            ]
            df_show = df_s[df_s["Param"].isin(key_params)].copy()
            title = "Tabla Larch v2 (specific, key+core)"

        for (partition, sample), df_sub in df_show.groupby(["Partition", "Sample"]):
            pivot = df_sub.pivot_table(
                index="Param",
                columns="ModeDummies",
                values="Value",
                aggfunc="first",
            ).sort_index()
            print(f"\n{title}: Betas — {partition} ({sample})")
            display(pivot)
else:
    print("⚠️ No hay params v2 cargados (`df_params_nl_ext_v2_larch`). Ejecuta `load-results-nested-ext-v2-larch`.")
